description: The inputs of the boundary datasets (tool/geo). Each is pinned by version, size and SHA-256. A downloaded input names its URL: fetch_geo_sources.py downloads and checks it. An Overture input names its remote file and columns: fetch_overture_divisions.py copies and checks it. The build scripts refuse a file that does not match.

files.name: GeoNames countryInfo.txt
files.provided_by: GeoNames publishes this file without versions and changes it daily, so it cannot be downloaded again as it was. It comes from the locked GeoNames download of tool/datasets/geonames_sources.lock.json and its source archive (DEC-019).

files.name: Overture Maps divisions, division, selected columns
files.license: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation); rows that come from geoBoundaries, Esri Community Maps and Land Information New Zealand are CC BY 4.0
files.provided_by: tool/geo/fetch_overture_divisions.py copies the columns named here from the remote file of the release. The size and SHA-256 are those of that copy as DuckDB 1.5.6 wrote it on 2026-10-09, not of the remote file.
files.columns: id, subtype, class, admin_level, country, region, names, wikidata, local_type, parent_division_id, population, capital_division_ids, capital_of_divisions, perspectives, sources, version, geometry
